statement: (α : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup α] (p a b c : α) (x : a ≡ b [PMOD p]) (x : b ≡ c [PMOD p]) (m : ℤ) (hm : b - a = m • p) (n : ℤ) (hn : c - b = n • p) : c - a = (m + n) • p
proof: simp [add_smul, ← hm, ← hn]

statement: (α : Type u_1) [AddCommSemigroup α] [PartialOrder α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] [AddLeftMono α] [Sub α] [OrderedSub α] (a b c : α) (hb : AddLECancellable b) (h : b ≤ a) : a - b = c ↔ a = c + b
proof: rw [eq_comm, hb.eq_tsub_iff_add_eq_of_le h, eq_comm]

statement: (ι : Type u) (ι' : Type w) (f : ι → Cardinal.{v}) (g : ι' → Cardinal.{v}) : (⨆ i, f i) * ⨆ j, g j = ⨆ i, ⨆ j, f i * g j
proof: simp_rw [Cardinal.ciSup_mul f, Cardinal.mul_ciSup g]

statement: (𝕜 : Type u) (ι : Type v) (E : ι → Type wE) (G : Type wG) [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [(i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [(i : ι) → NormedSpace 𝕜 (E i)] [SeminormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace 𝕜 G] [Fintype ι] (f : ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 E G) (m : (i : ι) → E i) (C : ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (hC : ‖f‖ ≤ C) (hm : ∀ (i : ι), ‖m i‖ ≤ b i) : ‖f‖ * ∏ i, ‖m i‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, b i
proof:
gcongr
exacts [f.opNorm_nonneg.trans hC, hm _]

statement: (𝕜 : Type u_1) [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] (E : Type u_2) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] (F : Type u_3) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] (f : E → F) (x : E) (s t : Set E) (h : DifferentiableWithinAt 𝕜 f t x) (st : s ⊆ t) : DifferentiableWithinAt 𝕜 f s x
proof:
rcases h with ⟨f', hf'⟩
exact ⟨f', hf'.mono st⟩

statement: (α : Type u_2) [GeneralizedCoheytingAlgebra α] (a b : α) (h : Disjoint a b) : (a ⊔ b) \ a = b
proof: rw [sup_sdiff, sdiff_self, bot_sup_eq, h.sdiff_eq_right]

statement: (α : Type u) (β : Type v) [SemilatticeSup β] (l : Filter α) (f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : α → β) (hf : f₁ ≤ᶠ[l] f₂) (hg : g₁ ≤ᶠ[l] g₂) : f₁ ⊔ g₁ ≤ᶠ[l] f₂ ⊔ g₂
proof: filter_upwards [hf, hg] with x hfx hgx using sup_le_sup hfx hgx

statement: (α : Type u_1) (ι : Sort u_4) (l : Filter α) (p : ι → Prop) (s : ι → Set α) (hl : l.HasBasis p s) (q : α → Prop) : (∀ᶠ (x : α) in l, q x) ↔ ∃ i, p i ∧ ∀ ⦃x : α⦄, x ∈ s i → q x
proof: simpa using hl.mem_iff

statement: (α : Type u) [PseudoEMetricSpace α] (m n : ℕ) (x x2 : Fin m → α) (y y2 : Fin n → α) : edist (Fin.append x y) (Fin.append x2 y2) = max (edist x x2) (edist y y2)
proof:
simp [edist_pi_def, Finset.sup_univ_eq_iSup, ← Equiv.iSup_comp (e := finSumFinEquiv),
  Prod.edist_eq, iSup_sum]

statement: (n : ℕ) (x x x : Fin n) (a : ℕ) (isLt : a < n) (b : ℕ) (isLt : b < n) (c : ℕ) (isLt : c < n) : a * (b + c) ≡ a * b + a * c [MOD n]
proof: rw [mul_add]

statement: (X : Type u) (κ : Cardinal.{v}) (h : HasCardinalLT X κ) (Y : Type u') (f : X → Y) (hf : Function.Surjective f) : HasCardinalLT Y κ
proof:
dsimp [HasCardinalLT] at h ⊢
rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, u}, Cardinal.lift_lift, Cardinal.lift_lift]
rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, u'}, Cardinal.lift_lift, Cardinal.lift_lift] at h
exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Cardinal.mk_le_of_surjective
  (Function.Surjective.comp ULift.up_surjective (Function.Surjective.comp hf
    ULift.down_surjective))) h

statement: (𝕜 : Type u) [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] (E : Type w) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] (𝕜' : Type u_1) [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜'] [NormedAlgebra 𝕜 𝕜'] (h₂ : 𝕜' → 𝕜') (h₂' y : 𝕜') (f : E → 𝕜') (f' : E →L[𝕜] 𝕜') (x : E) (hh : HasDerivAt h₂ h₂' y) (hf : HasFDerivAt f f' x) (hy : y = f x) : HasFDerivAt (h₂ ∘ f) (h₂' • f') x
proof:
rw [hy] at hh
exact hh.comp_hasFDerivAt x hf

statement: (E : Type u_1) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : E → ℝ) (f' : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : E) (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f f' x) (h₀ : f x < 0) : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun x => |f x|) (-f') x
proof:
convert (hasStrictDerivAt_abs_neg h₀).hasStrictFDerivAt.comp x hf using 1
ext y
simp

statement: (α : Type u) [Semiring α] (I : Ideal α) (a : α) (m n : ℕ) (ha : a ^ m ∈ I) (h : m ≤ n) : a ^ n ∈ I
proof:
rw [← Nat.add_sub_of_le h, add_comm, pow_add]
exact I.mul_mem_left _ ha

statement: (a b c d : ℤ) (hb : b < 0) (hd : d < 0) (hba : b ∣ a) (hdc : d ∣ c) : a / b ≤ c / d ↔ d * a ≤ c * b
proof:
obtain ⟨⟨x, rfl⟩, y, rfl⟩ := hba, hdc
simp [*, Int.ne_of_lt, Int.ne_of_gt, d.mul_assoc, b.mul_comm]

statement: (a b : ℕ) (hab : a.Coprime b) (hgcd : a.gcd b = 1) : ↑a * a.gcdA b + ↑b * a.gcdB b ≡ 1 [ZMOD ↑b]
proof:
rw [← Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab, hgcd]
rfl

statement: (K : Type u_2) (S : Type u_4) [CommRing S] [Field K] [Algebra K S] (x y : S) (r : K) (h : IsConjRoot K x y) : IsConjRoot K (x + (algebraMap K S) r) (y + (algebraMap K S) r)
proof: rw [isConjRoot_def, minpoly.add_algebraMap x r, minpoly.add_algebraMap y r, h]

statement: (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R] (x y z : R) (H1 : IsCoprime x z) (H2 : x ∣ y * z) : x ∣ y
proof:
let ⟨a, b, H⟩ := H1
rw [← mul_one y, ← H, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
exact dvd_add (dvd_mul_left _ _) (H2.mul_left _)

statement: (K : Type u_1) (L : Type u_2) (M : Type u_3) [CommRing K] [CommRing L] [CommRing M] (i : K →+* L) (p : ℕ) [ExpChar M p] [IsPRadical i p] (h : pNilradical M p = ⊥) (f g : L →+* M) (heq : (fun f => f.comp i) f = (fun f => f.comp i) g) : f = g
proof:
ext x
obtain ⟨n, y, hx⟩ := IsPRadical.pow_mem i p x
apply_fun _ using pow_expChar_pow_inj_of_pNilradical_eq_bot M p h n
simpa only [← map_pow, ← hx] using congr($(heq) y)

statement: (R : Type u_1) [Semiring R] (x : R) (hx : IsQuasiregular x) : IsUnit (1 + x)
proof:
obtain ⟨y, hy₁, hy₂⟩ := isQuasiregular_iff.mp hx
refine ⟨⟨1 + x, 1 + y, ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
convert congr(1 + $(hy₁)) using 1 <;> [noncomm_ring; simp]
convert congr(1 + $(hy₂)) using 1 <;> [noncomm_ring; simp]

statement: (X : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) (A : Type u_3) [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace A] (p : E → X) (s : Set A) (g₁ g₂ : A → E) (sep : IsSeparatedMap p) (inj : IsLocallyInjective p) (hs : IsPreconnected s) (h₁ : ContinuousOn g₁ s) (h₂ : ContinuousOn g₂ s) (he : Set.EqOn (p ∘ g₁) (p ∘ g₂) s) (a : A) (has : a ∈ s) (ha : g₁ a = g₂ a) : Set.EqOn g₁ g₂ s
proof:
rw [← Set.restrict_eq_restrict_iff] at he ⊢
rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict] at h₁ h₂
rw [isPreconnected_iff_preconnectedSpace] at hs
exact sep.eq_of_comp_eq inj h₁ h₂ he ⟨a, has⟩ ha

statement: (M : Type u_1) [Monoid M] (a : M) (h : IsUnit a) (y : M) : (fun x => x * a) (y * ↑h.unit⁻¹) = y
proof: simp [mul_assoc]

statement: (M : Type u_1) [Monoid M] (a b : M) : IsUnit a → IsUnit b → IsUnit (a * b)
proof:
rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩ ⟨y, rfl⟩
exact ⟨x * y, rfl⟩

statement: (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R] (S : Submonoid R) (M : Type v) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (s' s : ↥S) (m : M) : 1 • s • s' • m = 1 • (s' * s) • m
proof:
simp only [mul_smul, one_smul]
rw [smul_comm]

statement: (α : Type u_4) (E : Type u_5) [SeminormedCommGroup E] [PseudoEMetricSpace α] (f g : α → E) (hf : LocallyLipschitz f) (hg : LocallyLipschitz g) : LocallyLipschitz fun x => f x * g x
proof: simpa [← locallyLipschitzOn_univ] using hf.locallyLipschitzOn.mul hg.locallyLipschitzOn

statement: (a b c d : ℕ) (hab : a < b) (hcd : c < d) : a + c + 1 < b + d
proof: omega
